title: Mweya Munyoro Pakati Pevaprofita
intro: Izwi rinoshevedzera kururama rinonzwika mundima dzeKorani Yepamusoro. Mweya uyu wakaropafadzwa wakapihwa huporofita nemagwaro matsvene panguva iyo nhungamiro yaidiwa zvikuru pakati pevana veIsraeri. Munhu uyu akataura zvakananga kuvanhu vake, achivakurudzira kurangarira Ishe wavo. Kuburikidza nemoyo murefu nekuzvipira, vakava mwenje wechiedza une nyaya inojekesa mapeji emagwaro matsvene. Ungaziva here munhu uyu anoshamisa ane zita rinokudzwa muKorani neEvhangeri?
clues: Ndakakudzwa neuporofita nebhuku rekudenga panguva yekushaiwa kwevanhu vangu.
Amai vangu vakandibereka nenzira inoshamisa, kuburikidza nemurairo waMwari chete.
Ndakataura nevanhu vangu, ndichiti, 'Imi vana veIsraeri! Ndiri mutumwa waAllah kwamuri, ndichisimbisa zvakauya pamberi pangu.'
Ndakauya nezviratidzo zvakajeka kubva kuna Tenzi wako, ndichiuya nemashoko akanaka emuporofita anonzi Ahmad.
Amai vangu vaiva mukadzi akarurama akazvipira kuna Allah kubva paudiki hwangu.
Allah vakandidzidzisa Quran uye vakandiita kuti ndive netsitsi uye ndive neruremekedzo kuna amai vangu, uye handina kuzvikudza kana kusateerera.
arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرًۢا بِرَسُولٍۢ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِى ٱسْمُهُۥٓ أَحْمَدُ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verse: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allāh to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad." But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic." (61:6)
